description: Lists visitors subscribed to status page updates by email (they receive emails about incident reports and planned maintenances). Returns each subscriber with `status` (`confirmed`, `pending`, `expired`, `unsubscribed`) and dates, plus `stats`: confirmed/pending counts, `total` (confirmed + pending) and the plan `limit` of active subscribers per page. Requires a plan with `status_page_subscribers_limit > 0` — otherwise the list is empty.
name: status_page_subscriber_list
title: List subscribers of a status page
